blurb: Guests charter private yachts featuring full bars, dance floors, karaoke, and indoor and outdoor lounges. Yachts are available year-round and suitable for corporate events, holiday parties, anniversaries, engagements, and bachelor/bachelorette parties. Guests can bring their own themed decorations and food from local caterers to customize their experience.

quotes.author: James
quotes.text: James3 months agoI’ve been on board the Tiki Mermaid several times, and every experience has been fantastic. The entire crew is friendly, professional, and incredibly accommodating. Captain Dave is always a pleasure to work with and goes above and beyond to make sure everything runs smoothly.The bartender was amazing, and the rest of the crew made everyone feel welcome and taken care of from start to finish.Thank you for another great experience! I can’t wait to book with the Tiki Mermaid again and get back out on the water.

quotes.author: Georgia De Vito
quotes.text: Georgia De Vito2 months agoI took a Tiki Mermaid cruise for my friend's birthday and had a great time!! All the staff, captain, bartender, manager, we're so nice and helpful!! She also decorated the boat and brought catering which worked out so nicely! Bartender was able to help everyone quickly, even when it seemed we all decided to order at the same time. I'm also very prone to motion sickness but had 0 problems. Would highly recommend!!

quotes.author: Richard R. Brown
quotes.text: Richard R. Brown4 years agoTiki Mermaid was a blast! We took a booze cruise at the Marina as a company excursion and I had a lot of fun. The boat itself was huge. It even had a dance area. The crew was very nice and helpful. The bartender was great as well. My favorite part was the views! Spectacular sunset. I had so much fun, I want to do it again!

quotes.author: Felicia Bennett
quotes.text: Felicia Bennett9 months agoThe team at this company is fantastic - professional, kind, and fun! Had the pleasure of sailing with Captain Dave, Samantha, and Kayla. I would highly recommend a day out on their Tiki Too boat. Very spacious, tidy, safe, and well tended atmosphere all round.

quotes.author: tiffanyrusso513
quotes.text: tiffanyrusso5137 years agoI had the best time with this company!!! They were so awesome from the beginning to the end. I had about 22 people for a sunset ride and it was amazing! The food and staff was so nice. Would definitely do it again!!

quotes.author: sabine hansen
quotes.text: sabine hansen2 months agoTerrific time and incredible hosts! Couldn't be happier with our experience aboard the Tiki Mermaid with the team. Thanks for making sure our night was filled with laughs and good times! Will be coming back!
